title: Order event
description: An order event on orders-topic. Mirrors the orders table: keep the two in step (a test checks that they agree).

orderId.description: Letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Equals the Kafka key.

amount.description: A JSON number, never text. Greater than 0, at most 2 decimal places.

currency.description: Three uppercase letters, an ISO-4217 code such as USD.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with a UTC offset, such as 2025-04-03T10:00:00Z.
